name: Phong Dien floating market
kicker: Small farm-boat market on the river at Nhơn Ái
summary: Smaller floating market about 17 km out: drift among farm boats at dawn, with fewer visitors than Cái Răng. Farmers sell fruit and greens straight from their gardens. Be there by 5:30, when the busiest hour starts. Pick it for a second morning on the water, or when you want the quieter market.
getThere: About 17 km by road on tỉnh lộ 923
heroCaption: Small boats with produce on the river at Phong Điền
body: Small boats meet on the river at Nhơn Ái, loaded with fruit and greens from the gardens along the bank. Farmers sell straight onto the water. It is one of the city's two well-known floating markets, with Cái Răng.
Come early. The busiest hour is about 5:30 to 6:30. You see fewer tourist boats here than at Cái Răng, the large wholesale market closer to town.
Mỹ Khánh village lies between the two markets, so the orchards and Trúc Lâm Phương Nam monastery fit in after the boats.

figures.caption: A vendor rowing her boat of greens through the market
figures.alt: A woman in a conical hat rowing a small boat of vegetables at the Phong Dien floating market

gettingThere: The market is on tỉnh lộ 923 at ấp Nhơn Lộc, xã Nhơn Ái, about 17 km from the centre. Drive out on đường 30/4 and đường 3/2, cross the Cái Răng bridge, then follow tỉnh lộ 923 for 15 km. Book the ride the night before so you arrive by 5:30.

legs.heading: From Ninh Kiều
legs.body: By car or motorbike, about 17 km on tỉnh lộ 923.

admissionNote: No market ticket is published. Agree a boat fare at the landing before you board.
